dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, perfect timing. I was just about to go look for you.

choices.text: Xingqiu, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Thank you! Wow, your penmanship is beautiful! Much better than mine...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Every Lantern Rite, the Feiyun Commerce Guild sends gift envelopes to our business partners...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Great-grandpa always writes them by hand as a sign of respect. His calligraphy is a sight to behold — so sharp and elegant.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: In the eyes of our business partners, his envelopes are more valuable than any gift. They even frame them and put them on display.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I suppose, in this case, the pen might even be mightier than gold.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Much better, thanks to you. He has enough energy to scold me for my lack of penmanship, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: He also said I should follow your example, strive to become a young hero like you...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Eventually, my brother came over and distracted him so I could slip away. Otherwise, he might have nagged me until the end of time...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hahaha, I appreciate that, but there's no need to be so polite. It's too old-fashioned for my taste.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I'll give you my gift envelope in a few days. I just need to wrap up a few things at home, and then we can grab a meal with Xiangling to celebrate.

choices.text: We can learn from each other.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: See you around. The mountain roads can be dangerous, so be careful!
